chapter.verse: A hang pen sanggamte aw, na phawk loh ding uh kong deihsak loh thu ah: i pupite a vekun meii nuai-ah om uh a, a vekun tuipi kantan uh hi.
A vekun meii sung leh tuipi sungah Moses tawh kibaptize uh a,
a vekun kha an nekhawmin
a vekun kha tui dawnkhawm uh hi. A hang pen amaute a tonpih ahi, kha tawh kisai Suangpi pan a dawnkhawm uh hi a, tua Suangpi pen Khris ahi hi.
Himah taleh amaute a tamzaw' tungah Pasian lungkim lo ahih manin gamgawtak lakah a luang uh kithehthang hi.
Hih thute pen eite' etsakna lim dinga piang hi a, amaute bangin a hoihlo nate i lunggulh loh nading ahi hi.
Amaute kimkhat bangin milim bia kei ni. “Mite zune sane-in tu uh a, tua ciangin laam kipanin tawndian ngeingai uh hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.
Amaute kimkhat bangin nulepa tatkhialhna i zul kei ding hi. Tua mite nikhat thu-in thennih-le-tulthum pukin si uh hi.
Amaute kimkhat bangin Khris i zia-et kei ding hi. Tua mite in gulte' tuklup tuak uh hi.
Amaute kimkhat bangin i phun kei ding hi. Tua mite in Susiapa' suksiatna tuak uh hi.
Hihte pen amau' ading etsakna lim dinga piang hi a, ahi zongin khanghun beina a tuakkha ding ahi eite' ading ahihleh hilhphawnna ahi dingin a kigelhkhia ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin kiptak ka ding hi a ci mi peuhmah a pukkhak loh nading kidawm ta hen.

Mite' tuah ngeiloh siatzolna na tuak kei ding uh hi. Pasian muanhuai ahih manin note' do zawhloh siatzolna hong tuaksak lo ding a, na do zawh nadingun tua siatzolna tawh kitonin pusuahna zawi zong hong koihsak ding hi.
Tua hangin kong itte aw, milim biakna na peel un.
Thu a ngaihsun thei mite' tunga thugen bangin hong gen ka hi hi; kong gen thute nomaumah in na khentel un.
Hehpihna i phat ahi thupha hai pen Khris' sisan tawh i kizopna hilo ahi hiam? I balnen ahi anlum pen Khris' pumpi tawh i kizopna hilo ahi hiam?
Anlum pum khat bek ahih manin tampi ahi eite zong pumpi khat i hi hi. A hang pen i vekpi-in tua anlum pum khat i nekhawm hi.
Cilesa vai ah Israel ahite lungngai dih un. Biakpiak an a nete biakpiaktau tawh a kizom uh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua ahihleh ka cihnop bang ahi hiam? Milim thoihna an ahi-a a milim ahi zongin thupi a ci nuam ka hi hiam?
Hilo hi. Gangawh biakpiak a bawl uh ciangin a thoih uh pen dawite hi a, Pasian hilo hi. Note dawi tawh na kizop ding uh kong deihsak kei hi.
Topa' hai leh dawite' hai na dawnkhawm thei kei ding uh hi. Topa' sabuai leh dawite' sabuai na uumkhawm thei kei ding uh hi.
Topa' lungsim phinbawl ding i hi hiam? Amah sangin hatzaw i hi hiam?
“Na khempeuh hihtheih nading thu om,” ahih hangin na khempeuh kimanna a nei kim hilo hi. “Na khempeuh hihtheih nading thu om,” ahih hangin na khempeuh in hong phungvuh kim lo hi.
Kuamah in ama' phattuam nading bek ci lo-in a vengte' phattuam nading zon sawm ta hen.
Sumbuk-a kizuak peuhpeuh bangmah dongtel se lo-in kitheihtawmna lungsim tawh ne un.
A hang pen leitung leh leitunga om khempeuh Topa' a ahi hi.
Thu-umlo mi khatpeuh in hong samin note zong na hawhnop uhleh note' mai-a hong kiluui peuhpeuh bangmah dongtel se lo-in kitheihtawmna lungsim tawh ne un.
Ahih hangin mi khatpeuh in, “Hih pen milim thoihna an hi,” hong cih leh tua mipa ahi zongin, kitheihtawmna lungsim ahi zongin, na khualna-un tua an ne kei un.

Tua ka cih ciangin ka gennop pen note hilo-in hong ci mipa' kitheihtawmna lungsim ahi hi. A hang pen midang khat ii kitheihtawmna lungsim in bang hangin keima' suahtakna hong ciangtansak thei laizang ding ahi hiam?
Lungdam ko-in ne ka hihleh tua lungdam ka kohna thu hangin mawhsak gensiat thuak laizang ding ka hi hiam?
Tua hi a, nekna dawnna-a kipan na hih peuhpeuh uh a vekin Pasian' minphatna ahi dingin hih un.
Jew mi leh Greek mi ahi-a Pasian' pawlpi ahi zongin lunghamsak kei un.
Kei zong mi khempeuh' lungkim nading ka hanciam hi. Keima' aituam hamphat nading sangin mi tampi hotkhiat a ngah nadingun amau' hamphat nading a zong ka hi hi.
